title: 第9章 造化炉第10章 你我的小秘密
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 莫阳默默探查完纳戒后，心中乐开了花。
他满脸笑意的看向苏菲儿，开口道：“我说话算数，今后咱们便井水不犯河水，不过前提是你别来找我麻烦！”
苏菲儿冷哼了一声，开口道：“哼，谁想找你，本姑娘之前只是好奇而已！”
莫阳急忙摆手，道：“大小姐，千万别对哥心生好奇，不然你早晚要沦陷进去！”
苏菲儿冷哼了一声，也没有停留，转身便离开了小院。
见苏菲儿离开，莫阳便迫不及待的转身走进屋中，将房门紧紧合上，随后直接进入石塔中。
他直径来到第二层，来到那丹炉前，黝黑的丹炉透着一股古朴的气息，与莫阳齐肩。
此时仔细打量，莫阳才发现那丹炉上有三个黝黑的字体。
上面三个古字竟然是造化炉！
丹炉四周已经被他之前清理干净了，除了那本神丹道外，还有两本古卷手稿，上面所记录的都是一些炼丹的心得。
对莫阳来说，那两卷炼丹心得好比一个丹术造诣非凡的师父。
这几天以来，他已经彻底熟记在心了。
丹炉中，有一簇赤红色的火焰，不急不缓的燃烧，也不知多少年了。
“难道是天地中的某种异火，否则绝不可能一直不灭……这丹炉叫造化炉，这火……我就给你取名叫造化之火吧！”莫阳围着丹炉打量了许久，一番嘀咕后给那火焰取了一个名字。
随后他开始准备药材。
神丹道书卷中对丹药有一个大体的归类，从简单到复杂，所需的药材亦是各有不同。
越是普通的丹药，所需药材的种类少且用量也不大，而且药材也很普通，容易寻到，而那些炼制灵丹的药材不仅种类繁多，而且有些是一些罕世灵药。
莫阳打算炼制的第一种丹药便是那古卷中记录的第一种丹方，名为洗髓丹！
洗髓丹，顾名思义便是洗精伐髓，除去体内的污浊杂质，提升修者自身的根骨，甚至能达到无尘无垢的地步，而且对真气也有作用，有助于真气凝练。
莫阳之所以选择炼制洗髓丹，因为洗髓丹最适合修为低的修者服用，从开始便改善根骨，对今后的修行有莫大的好处，其次便是炼制这种丹药所需的药材最少，只有两种。
“百灵藤，长参须，才两种药材，我已熟记炼丹法诀和要领，应该很容易炼制吧！”
莫阳取出两种药材，深吸一口气，随后以对应的分量开始炼制。
他本以为一切会很顺利，但百灵藤投入丹炉的一瞬间，直接被那赤红色的火苗烧成了一团粉末，莫阳连反应都未来得及。
“我已经用真气将药材包裹住，为何……”
莫阳皱眉沉吟片刻，开始尝试第二次，只是结果与第一次一般无二。
随后第三次，第四次，第五次……
也不知过了多久，纳戒中的百灵藤已经被消耗大半了，莫阳依旧没有成功。
虽然后面几次，那药材在丹炉中已经开始被炼化，但稍不留神便功亏一篑。
莫阳感觉自己快崩溃了，有了丹方，有了炼丹法诀……
一切都已经齐备，他没想到的是炼丹过程竟然如此之难。
content_en:
After Mo Yang silently explored Najie, he felt happy.
He looked at Sophie with a smile on his face and said, "I keep my word. From now on, we will keep our peace, but the premise is that you don't come to trouble me!"
Sophie snorted coldly and said, "Humph, who wants to find you? I was just curious before!"
Mo Yang waved his hand hurriedly and said: "Miss, don't be curious about me, otherwise you will fall into it sooner or later!"
Sophie snorted coldly, turned around and left the courtyard without stopping.
Seeing Sophie leaving, Mo Yang couldn't wait to turn around and walk into the house, closed the door tightly, and then entered the stone tower directly.
He walked directly to the second floor and came to the alchemy furnace. The dark alchemy furnace exuded a simple atmosphere, standing shoulder to shoulder with Mo Yang.
Looking carefully at this time, Mo Yang discovered that there were three dark characters on the alchemy furnace.
The three ancient characters above turned out to be the furnace of creation!
The area around the alchemy furnace had been cleaned by him before. In addition to the divine alchemy book, there were also two ancient manuscripts, which recorded some experiences in alchemy.
To Mo Yang, those two volumes of alchemy experience were like a master with extraordinary attainments in alchemy.
Over the past few days, he has memorized it thoroughly.
In the alchemy furnace, there was a cluster of crimson flames, burning unhurriedly for who knows how many years.
"Could it be some kind of strange fire in the world, otherwise it would never be extinguished forever... This alchemy furnace is called the Creation Furnace, and this fire... I will name you the Fire of Creation!" Mo Yang looked around the alchemy furnace for a long time, and then gave the flame a name after muttering.
Then he began to prepare the medicinal materials.
There is a general classification of elixirs in the Shendan Dao books, from simple to complex, and the required medicinal materials are also different.
The more common elixirs are, the fewer types of medicinal materials are needed and the dosage is not large, and the medicinal materials are also very common and easy to find. The medicinal materials used to refine elixirs are not only diverse, but some are rare elixirs.
The first elixir that Mo Yang plans to refine is the first elixir recorded in the ancient scroll, called the Marrow Cleansing Pill!
Marrow Cleansing Pill, as the name suggests, cleanses the essence and cuts the marrow, removes the dirty impurities in the body, improves the practitioner's own bones, and can even reach the point of being dust-free and dirt-free. It also has an effect on the true energy and helps to condense the true energy.
The reason why Mo Yang chose to refine the Marrow Cleansing Pill was because the Marrow Cleansing Pill was most suitable for practitioners with low cultivation levels. It would improve the bones from the beginning and would be of great benefit to future practice. The second reason was that the fewest medicinal materials needed to refine this pill were only two.
"The Bailing Vine and the Long Ginseng Beard are just two medicinal materials. I have memorized the alchemy formula and essentials. It should be easy to refine it!"
Mo Yang took out two medicinal materials, took a deep breath, and then started refining them in the corresponding amounts.
He thought everything would go smoothly, but the moment Bailing Vine was thrown into the alchemy furnace, it was directly burned into a ball of powder by the red flames, and Mo Yang didn't even have time to react.
"I have wrapped the medicinal materials with my true energy, why..."
Mo Yang frowned and pondered for a moment, then tried a second time, but the result was the same as the first time.
Then the third time, the fourth time, the fifth time...
I don’t know how long it took, but most of the Bailing Vine in the Najie had been consumed, and Mo Yang still failed.
Although the medicinal materials had begun to be refined in the alchemy furnace a few times later, the success would fall short if one was not careful.
Mo Yang felt like he was about to collapse. He had the elixir recipe and the alchemy formula...
Everything was ready, but what he didn't expect was that the alchemy process would be so difficult.
